exchanges: omg i survived move in day
Congrats! Move-in day is chaos. How's the dorm?
tiny. like i can touch both walls lol. but kelowna is so pretty, the lake is rigth there
The lake views make up for a lot of small rooms.
my roomate is freya shes from calgary and she brought a mini fridge so i love her already
A roommate with a mini fridge is a great start.
shes in kinesiology and wants to be a physio. im in psychology so we both have stats first year lol
Shared classes with your roommate could make studying easier.
our RA came by, aisha, she did a whole floor meeting abt quiet hours
RAs always do that first-week talk. Did she seem nice?
ya super nice. shes from nairobi and moved here for her masters
So she's fairly new to the city too, she probably gets what first years are going through.
frist week of classes is insane. so much reading
The first week tends to front-load everything. It gets more manageable once you figure out what actually matters.
my chem lab TA is ALSO named aisha. whats the odds
Two Aishas in your first week, that's a fun coincidence.
she grew up in karachi and she is v strict about goggles lol
Strict about goggles is the right kind of strict for a chem lab.
freya joined the rowing team, they practice at like 5am. shes insane
That's a special kind of dedicated. Hopefully she's quiet when she leaves.
she is!! shes a good roomate
That's half the battle in first year.
ugh my throat is killing me. like swallowing glass
That sounds miserable. If it's really bad or you have a fever, the campus clinic is worth a visit.
went to the clinic. the dr thinks its tonsillitis, they swabbed me
At least you got seen quickly. Rest and fluids in the meantime.
dr baptiste was rly nice abt it. gave me a note for my lab
That's helpful, missing lab is a pain to sort out otherwise.
my mom keeps texting me pics of juniper. shes moping by the door apparently
Dogs definitely notice when someone leaves. She misses you.
shes a golden retreiver and shes so dumb i love her
Goldens are the sweetest kind of dumb.
update the clinic called, swab came back and its strep actually, not the other thing. so antibiotics now
Good that they caught it. You should feel a lot better after a day or two on them.
freya is being so nice she got me soup from the caf
Soup delivery from a roommate is real friendship.
met a guy in my psych class, tevita. hes hilarious
Nice, someone to sit with in a big lecture makes it way better.
we have the same 8am so we suffer together
Shared suffering at 8am is a strong bond.
applied for a job at the campus bookstore, like 10 hrs a week
That's a manageable amount with classes. Hope you get it.
got it!! start next week
Congrats! That's quick.
back in brandon i worked at a grocery store so this is way better
Sounds like a nice upgrade from grocery shifts.
fr. ok so its reading week soon and i have no plans
Reading week could be a nice chance to explore the area.
tevita said i should come watch his rugby game saturday
That could be fun, even if you don't know the rules.
i dont know the rules at ALL lol. hes a forward whatever that means
Forwards are the big ones in the scrums. You'll pick it up watching.
freyas coming too so ill have someone to ask
Perfect, a sporty roommate is a good game buddy.
